Chapter 1132: 3 Meeting The Emperor (Request For Subscription)_2

Chapter 1132: Chapter 3 Meeting the Emperor (Request for Subscription)_2

After experiencing the war between the Qingfen Domain and the Purple Dream Domain, Lin Yuan is now quite wealthy.

Speaking of Lin Yuan’s character, unless absolutely necessary, he wouldn’t easily resort to action, so he was not in a hurry for weapons and armor for now.

“These are three Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams.”

The illusory elder smiled slightly, and in front of him appeared three ‘diagrams’ covered in shining light, with Chaos Qi swirling around them.

“Descendant of Fierce Sun, please swear in the name of Fierce Sun not to spread these three Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams.”

The illusory elder looked at Lin Yuan.

“Alright.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

“In the name of Fierce Sun…”

Lin Yuan repeated as the illusory elder requested.

The moment Lin Yuan finished speaking, an exceedingly obscure gaze glanced at him from the eternal Fierce Sun above the firmament.

Lin Yuan had a feeling that if he ever broke his oath, he would be struck by that eternal Fierce Sun.

A strike from a thirteenth-level time lifeform—who could withstand it? Any means of resurrection would be futile, erasing everything from the source.

In the Chaos Void, there also exists a method of swearing in the name of the Chaos Void Origin, but how could that outcome compare to swearing in the name of a thirteenth-level time lifeform?

The Chaos Void holds no specific disdain, but a thirteenth-level time lifeform does.

“No wonder there are so many inheritance guides in the treasure house, and not a single one has ever been leaked…” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Even if powerful enemies from other ancient countries infiltrated the capital of Fierce Sun, and had already obtained some inheritance guides, they still couldn’t spread them out, rendering it somewhat pointless.

“I wonder what consequences I’ll face if I leak these secret diagrams in the Chaos Void…” Lin Yuan pondered.

Without a doubt, as long as it’s in this Origin World, the moment the oath is broken, the Ancestor of Fierce Sun would perceive it.

But in the Chaos Void?

It’s another dimensional space where even a thirteenth-level time lifeform can hardly make an impact.

…

After making the oath.

Lin Yuan deducted 120,000 credits and simultaneously accepted the three Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams.

“The fundamental veins of chaos rules manifest…”

The moment Lin Yuan received them, he was immediately struck by the chaos mysteries contained within.

Compared to the Chaos Secret Patterns within the war machines, these Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams were more direct and foundational.

After pausing for a moment, Lin Yuan immediately got up and left, returning to the royal residence to delve deeply into these Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams.

[Your comprehension is extraordinary, greatly increasing your enlightenment of chaos rules when gleaning the Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams…]

A large amount of inspiration surged through Lin Yuan’s mind.

Compared to understanding war machines, directly comprehending the Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams was significantly more efficient.

The Chaos Secret Patterns on the war machines are combinations and integrations of various Chaos Secret Patterns, each war machine possessing different abilities; some excel in assault, some in defense, others in domain suppression, and so on.

Major ancient countries classify the Chaos Secret Patterns on war machines as top secret, not because of the Chaos Secret Patterns themselves.

The eighty-one Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams are possessed by the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, Da Ling Ancient Country, Xuanyin Ancient Country, and other five great ancient countries.

The true value of the war machines lies in the utilization of the chaos rules they contain.

Mastering the corresponding application methods allows for mass production of similar war machines and even uncovering the weaknesses of such war machines.

In comprehending the war machines, Lin Yuan needed to perceive various chaotic rule mysteries among them, with some war machines containing Chaos Secret Patterns residing in portions of the first, third, and seventh Mystic Pattern Diagrams.

During periods of comprehension, Lin Yuan had to categorize them, expending some effort.

But directly comprehending the Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams was far simpler, allowing for sequential and straightforward immersion.

“Chaos Second Realm Peak?”

Lin Yuan’s eyes lit up. Initially, according to his prediction, with a continuous supply of war machines for comprehension, reaching the Chaos Second Realm Peak might take at most a thousand years or so.

Now, only five hundred years had passed. Although he was close to the Second Realm Peak, based on the previous speed of comprehension enhancement, he estimated it might still take four to five hundred years to completely step into it.

But now?

Through the understanding of the Chaos Secret Map, Lin Yuan felt stepping into the Second Realm Peak could be accomplished in just a few years.

Chaos rules consist of only three realms, and reaching the Second Realm Peak leaves just one step away from the highest, the Third Realm.

Most critically, after reaching the Second Realm Peak, Lin Yuan could contemplate evolving the Yin Yang Taiji Power through chaos rules.

The Great Lord of this Origin World, despite a foundation inferior to that of a Chaos Void Venerable, was able to stand as an equal due to the ability to evolve exclusive chaos power at the Great Lord level.

In the Chaos Void, this is a level only accessible to Great Saints.

…

The next day.

Lin Yuan ceased his training and came outside the royal residence.

King Chibao was already waiting outside, smiling as he looked at Lin Yuan and said, “Galaxy, quickly come with me to see His Majesty.”

“See His Majesty?”

Lin Yuan had anticipated this, knowing that upon arriving in the capital, he would surely need to meet the emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

“Actually, when you first arrived in the capital, His Majesty wanted to see you,” King Chibao said. “But he was concerned that you might not adapt, so he waited until today.”

“Thank you, Your Majesty.”

Lin Yuan said.

“No need to thank, we’re all family.”

King Chibao immediately took Lin Yuan to the core palace of the capital.

It was also where the palace of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country was located, the safest place in the entire capital.

The hall was grand and majestic. Lin Yuan followed King Chibao and quickly arrived at a grand hall.

“Chibao, Galaxy.”

The emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country was a weathered man with a rustic appearance and deep eyes. Upon seeing Lin Yuan and King Chibao, a smile immediately appeared on his face.

“Your Majesty.”

King Chibao bowed slightly.

Lin Yuan discreetly appraised the emperor with a glance.

In Lin Yuan’s perspective, the emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country seemed to be integrated with the palace and the entire Fierce Sun capital.

“That King Lingshen waged war just to become emperor of the Da Ling Ancient Country…” Lin Yuan suddenly understood, becoming one with the entire capital?

His physical body and bloodline would undergo transformations, and even an ordinary royal family member, over time, would have their bloodline concentration naturally reach the level of the core royal family.

Moreover, becoming the emperor of an ancient country allowed for the control of the entire ancient national capital’s grand formation, effortlessly suppressing Heavenly Venerate-level powerhouses.

This transcendence over everything, overlooking everything, indeed lures many powerhouses to pursue it.

“Seeing a royal member like you, I feel hopeful about the future of the ancient country.”

The emperor looked at Lin Yuan, smiling as he spoke.

Upon Lin Yuan’s entrance into the grand hall, he immediately confirmed that Lin Yuan carried the core royal bloodline of Fierce Sun, along with a rich Fierce Sun aura.

In terms of strength, the emperor was undeniably the strongest, but the emperor’s strength was temporary, while Lin Yuan’s strength belonged to himself.

“Alright, let’s discuss serious matters.” The emperor reflected for a moment, then looked at Lin Yuan and said, “Galaxy, now that you’ve chosen to join our royal family, naturally, it’s not without purpose.”

“With your strength and potential, you can oversee some special resource treasures.”

The emperor said with a smile.

“Oversee resource treasures?”

Lin Yuan’s heart was stirred.

The territory of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country was vast, and similarly, there were resource treasures naturally nurtured by the heavens and the earth.

It’s like the secret realms nurtured by the Chaos Void, producing special resources of invaluable worth.

Overseeing these resource treasures meant securing them for the ancient country. Ninety percent of the resources produced were to be handed over to the ancient country, while he could keep ten percent for himself.

In addition, based on the preciousness of each resource treasure, the overseer could receive regular credit income.

It should be noted that credits in the Fierce Sun Ancient Country were extremely difficult to obtain. Lin Yuan managed to reverse the situation in the war between the Qingfen Domain and the Purple Dream Domain, yet the final credit evaluation was only 120,000.

But by overseeing resource treasures, one could reap continuous credit rewards, naturally attracting many title-seeking kings.

A valuable resource treasure was like a money tree. Title-seeking kings had substantial daily consumption, and the more precious the treasures they oversee, the more income they gained, greatly assisting themselves.

“Galaxy, here is the current map of all treasures in the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, select three.”

The emperor waved his hand, and before him appeared a map of the entire territory of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, with many areas gleaming brightly.
